ambiguity.detail: What took three years to steal is not fully explained.

verdict.hook_line: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Ten days is plenty of time.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A duke defiantly enters a ten-day countdown against a corrupt priest and a scheming bride to save his marriage.
verdict.why_it_works: Establishes a ticking-clock conflict with strong defiance from the male lead and a chilling villainous final line.
